artifacts.summary: Seven-phase plan to rebase PR #648 onto upstream/main in an isolated worktree, reconcile Defs.lean against upstream Operators.lean, green the five upstream CI gates locally, and emit human-authored-only PR scaffolding without any push or gh write.

memory_candidates.content: When rebasing a fork's upstream PR branch in a repo whose main has diverged heavily, use a dedicated `git worktree add -b <work> <path> origin/<pr-branch>` rather than checking the PR branch out in place. In this repo an in-place checkout is actively destructive: `specs/` and `.claude/` are fork-only trees absent from upstream, so switching to a branch rooted at upstream would delete the task-management artifacts (or refuse due to local modifications). The worktree also makes the 'never let fork main become a merge/cherry-pick/conflict-resolution source' constraint structural rather than a matter of discipline, and gives a cheap file-count gate (PR branch and upstream each carry 3 files under Cslib/Logics/Propositional/; fork main carries 116) to confirm the workspace was created from the right ref. Cost: a fresh .lake requiring its own toolchain install and `lake exe cache get`.
